logic.note: Normally open contacts that close above the pull-in field and open below the drop-out field (hysteresis).

timing.note: Closes and opens at once; a real reed takes about 0.5 ms to operate and bounces for up to 0.5 ms (debounce in firmware).

analog.note: Field of an axially magnetised disc magnet on its axis; off-axis, tilted, or through steel the field is weaker. The pull-in field is a prop, converted from the datasheet's ampere-turns by hand.

power.note: Draws nothing; the pull-up it closes against draws VCC / R_pullup while it is closed (about 70 µA with an ESP32's 45 kΩ).

emulates: Magnet distance, size and grade → field at the switch
Contact closure for a GPIO wake-up
doesNotEmulate: Off-axis positions and the null zones of a reed beside a magnet
Glass breaking when the leads are bent too close
testOnRealDevice: Close and open the lid 20 times: it must switch every time at the gap your case gives
Bend the leads at least 2 mm from the glass, or it cracks
With a pull-up on a sleeping board, the closed switch draws VCC / R: open it in the resting position if you can
